orders.title: Order management
orders.description: Review orders from the mobile app: confirm prescription, assign lab tests, set collection schedule, then advance status through delivery.

labTests.title: Test catalog
labTests.description: Browse and edit the tests you offer: names, codes, prices, and whether each test is available.

staff.title: Lab staff
staff.description: Add and maintain people who work in the lab—roles control what they can do in the system.

users.title: Users
users.description: Manage patient and partner accounts: contact details, location, and loyalty balance.

collections.title: Collection & routing
collections.descriptionPending: Choose orders that need a sample pickup, then plan an efficient collection route.
collections.descriptionScheduled: Review scheduled pickups and mark one order at a time as collecting when sample collection begins.

results.title: Lab result management
results.description: Advance each order through lab processing, upload result PDFs when complete, run AI review, then release to the patient.

ratings.title: Ratings & feedback
ratings.description: Review patient and partner ratings with order context — patient, tests, status, and contact details.

discounts.title: Discounts
discounts.description: Configure a flat discount percentage for each lab test, with an optional active date range.

referralFees.title: Referral fees
referralFees.description: Configure a flat referral commission percentage for each lab test.

membershipTiers.title: Membership tiers
membershipTiers.description: Classify customers into points-based tiers (e.g. Normal, Silver, Gold), each with a discount that stacks on top of a test's own discount.

serviceGeofences.title: Service geofences
serviceGeofences.description: Define coverage zones with bounding boxes and delivery fees applied when patients place orders.

advertisements.title: Advertisements
advertisements.description: Manage promotional banners shown in the patient mobile app. Each ad can include an image, description, optional link, and schedule.

loyalty.title: Loyalty points
loyalty.description: Control how members earn points from spending, manage active promotions, and check point balances for your customers.

systemSettings.title: System settings
systemSettings.description: Configure the patient mobile app, lab contact details, and fees. Your admin dashboard theme and language are personal and stay on this device.

reports.title: Reports & analytics
reports.description: Dashboard KPIs, operational queues, staff performance, and financial summaries from the reporting API.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: Choose which modules each staff role can access in the website. Admin always has full access.

aiConfig.title: AI configuration
aiConfig.description: Manage Gemini and OpenAI models and API keys for patient AI summaries.

aiPrompts.title: AI prompts
aiPrompts.description: Create and edit reusable system prompts for AI conversations.
